Take the guess work out of aligning any TV antenna. Using your current location, your device's compass, and the target site's effective radiated power, Antenna Mate instantly estimates the signal strength of all nearby sites and automatically plots a bearing to the best one**.

Under normal circumstances you should get an initial result within seconds. The longer you leave Antenna Mate open, the more accurate it will become. For best results use Antenna Mate outside in an open space and away from objects which cause interference.

LanceX is multi-protocol proxy utility, it captures device network traffic and forward it to proxy server.

# Features

* Multiple protocol formats and data algorithms
* Shared proxy
* QR code tools
* Custom DNS/DoH/DoQ/DoT
* Custom traffic forwarding rules
* On-demand rules
* MitM HTTP decryption
* Subscription
* Various network diagnostic tools
* View traffic status
* iCloud configuration backup and restore
* No analysis of data to ensure privacy

# Support protocols

* Socks5
* VMess
* VLESS
* Trojan
* Shadowsocks
* HTTP

# Benefits and advantages

* Gives you online privacy and anonymity by creating a private network from a public internet connection
* Let you reach your internal network using secure connection from public internet 
* Change your current location by changing ip address

Feedback is important, if there are any concerns please let us know.

how many times did you get a color from shop and you realize it does not match the one already used ?? ICScanner scans the color and finds the corresponding of the standard palette "RAL" or "PANSTONE". provides you with the color code based on the selected palette and the respective RGB and HEX values. when making a scan, you can select the palette to use, and the accuracy of the scan. a low accuracy finds in the color palette the one closest to the scan. High accuracy returns the exact color if it is present in the palette. When a scan is performed, the value found is saved in the history and can be consulted at any time to retrieve the values ​​of a past scan.
